title: Japanese friction verb public development contrasts

provenance.sentence_provenance: Sentences written for this draft, without copying external examples or user text.
provenance.reference_provenance: First-party Taiwan Traditional Chinese references for these original sentences.

purpose: Contrast contact without assumed damage, explicit wear or fray, and nearby different verb shapes.

review_and_adoption.process: Independent language review and adoption must be recorded in a separate data-only PR before any rule uses these rows for acceptance.
review_and_adoption.scope_limit: The six rows cover contact, explicit wear and related verbs for development. They do not score the fixed sample.

items.jp: 歩くと、袖が机に擦れる。
items.zh_hant: 走路時，袖子會擦到桌子。
semantic_checks: 袖が is the thing making contact; 机に marks the contacted surface.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not establish damage, duration, or who walks.

control.source_cue: 袖が is the thing making contact; 机に marks the contacted surface.
stable: The Japanese and Taiwan Traditional Chinese sentences are original first-party development material.
changed: 袖が is the thing making contact; 机に marks the contacted surface.
limits: The source does not establish damage, duration, or who walks.

items.jp: この紐は箱の角に擦れます。
items.zh_hant: 這條繩子會和箱角摩擦。
semantic_checks: 紐は identifies the cord; 箱の角に marks the contact point.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not say that the cord is damaged or who moves it.

control.source_cue: 紐は identifies the cord; 箱の角に marks the contact point.
stable: The Japanese and Taiwan Traditional Chinese sentences are original first-party development material.
changed: 紐は identifies the cord; 箱の角に marks the contact point.
limits: The source does not say that the cord is damaged or who moves it.

items.jp: 何度も擦れて、靴のかかとがすり切れた。
items.zh_hant: 反覆摩擦後，鞋跟磨破了。
semantic_checks: 擦れて states repeated rubbing; すり切れた separately states resulting wear.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not specify the surface or identify the wearer.

limits: The source does not specify the surface or identify the wearer.
